name: lift_ablation
description: PhaseForge Lift ablation protocol under the canonical R50 method (six experts, top-2, centroid router, 50% partial expert warm-start). Wave 1: core matrix (dense floors, capacity control, negative control, scratch/warm-start MoE, R50-matched H1/H2 controls, generic clustering and phase-head router controls, spherical averaging, PhaseForge-FT, teacher-forced). Wave 2 (migrated to the canonical provider): expert scaling K=3/12 and phase-label corruption (25%/50%/permutation shuffle). Wave 3: one-warm-plus-random expert-init diagnostic (rotate-by-seed). Wave 4: expert-initialization suite at the canonical centroid router — full standard warm-start (EXP-212) and the partial-warm drop-rate sweep 0%/25%/75%/100% (EXP-213..216); 50% is the canonical proposed method (EXP-101). Removed as redundant after the canonical migration: pf_random_warm (= phase_pretrain_random_router at partial-warm), phaseforge_e6 and warmstart_r50 (= the canonical method itself), pf_jitter_00/pf_jitter_10 (superseded by the drop-rate sweep; jitter is inert under partial_warm). Oracle MoE remains an evaluation-time routing intervention on a fixed trained expert set.

methods.role: Wave 4 expert-init suite: full standard warm-start (every expert parameter copied from the Stage 1 action head with the declared small symmetry-breaking jitter) at the canonical centroid router — the pre-final PhaseForge initialization, preserved as an ablation of the canonical 50% partial warm-start.

methods.name: pf_drop100
